text: PRE-REVIEW EXACT-SOURCE MAP; no docs edit or authoring claim. I inspected immutable b33fe5b. Required source correspondence: (1) HsmmResultCodec.SchemaVersion is hsmm/v4. (2) The result wire carries required supportBasis as one TermWire per CostTerm; decode uses uniqueMap plus SupportBasis.fromEvidence to require exact complete coverage, finite nonnegative CostWeights, then compares it with the independently supplied expectedSupportBasis before rebuilding any cell. The embedded basis proves internal consistency only; it is not an execution receipt. (3) CostBreakdown.support is tagged: Assessed carries measuredTerms, eligibleTerms, eligibleWeights and accepts neither share nor reason; share is derived. Unestablished carries the same evidence plus reason EmptyEligibility or ZeroEligibleWeight, accepts no share, and decode recomputes the reason. NotApplicable carries only reason ExternalState or Unreachable and rejects measurement fields. (4) AlignWire rebinds recorded support to measuredTerms = priced terms minus imputed terms; priced terms must be eligible; eligible weights must equal the complete basis restricted to that eligible set. Source, unassessable, unreachable, and external records each admit only their matching support state. (5) v3 is refused; no migration can recover which support state or evidence applied. (6) Portability promise is canonical byte-exact decode/re-encode of one artifact, not cross-runtime inference bit identity. My later candidate review will fail any prose that implies the embedded basis authenticates provider execution or that share/reason are caller fields.
